title: SM Current Reference Generator
text: 同步电机电流参考生成器，输入 3 路、输出 3 路；{Nominal dc-link voltage (V)} 指定额定直流电压、{Maximum power (W)} 指定最大功率、{Maximum torque (N*m)} 指定最大转矩、{Maximum field current (A)} 指定最大励磁电流、{Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间、{Current references} 指定电流参考策略 Zero d-axis、{Torque constant (N*m/A)} 指定转矩常数、{Mechanical speed vector, wMechanical (rpm)} 指定转子转速查找向量、{Torque reference vector, TqRef (N*m)} 指定转矩参考查找向量、{DC-link voltage vector, Vdc (V)} 指定直流母线电压查找向量、{D-axis current reference matrix, id(wMechanical,TqRef,Vdc), (A)} 指定参考 d 轴电流值 zeros、{Q-axis current reference matrix, iq(wMechanical,TqRef,Vdc), (A)} 指定参考 q 轴电流值 zeros、{Field current reference matrix, iq(wMechanical,TqRef,Vdc), (A)} 指定励磁电流参考值 zeros，按实例取值。

params.name: Nominal dc-link voltage (V)
params.values: 额定直流电压 300 V (default) | positive number

params.name: Maximum power (W)
params.values: 最大功率 30000 W (default) | positive number

params.name: Maximum torque (N*m)
params.values: 最大转矩 250 N*m (default) | positive number

params.name: Maximum field current (A)
params.values: 最大励磁电流 25 A (default) | positive number

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: 模块采样时间 -1 (default) | -1 or positive number

params.name: Current references
params.values: 电流参考策略 Zero d-axis control (default) | Lookup-table based

params.name: Mechanical speed vector, wMechanical (rpm)
params.values: 转子转速查找向量 [0, 3000] (default) | positive monotonically increasing vector

params.name: Torque reference vector, TqRef (N*m)
params.values: 转矩参考查找向量 [-100, 0, 100] (default) | positive monotonically increasing vector

params.name: DC-link voltage vector, Vdc (V)
params.values: 直流母线电压查找向量 [300, 350] (default) | positive monotonically increasing vector

params.name: D-axis current reference matrix, id(wMechanical,TqRef,Vdc), (A)
params.values: 参考 d 轴电流值 zeros(2,3,2) (default) | real matrix

params.name: Q-axis current reference matrix, iq(wMechanical,TqRef,Vdc), (A)
params.values: 参考 q 轴电流值 zeros(2,3,2) (default) | real matrix

params.name: Field current reference matrix, iq(wMechanical,TqRef,Vdc), (A)
params.values: 励磁电流参考值 zeros(2,3,2) (default) | real matrix
